title.description: The title on the Artifacts screen. Required for a new artifact; on a new version, empty keeps the title

file_path.description: A file to publish, in the session's working directories or scratchpad. Pass this or content

content.description: The text to publish. Pass this, with name, or file_path

name.description: With content: a file name whose extension says what it is, such as report.html

artifact_id.description: Publish a new version of this artifact

description.description: A short label of what this call works on or looks for, shown to the user as its row: a noun phrase of 2 to 6 words, no leading verb
